name: ANTH 3028W
title: Indigenous Rights and Aboriginal Australia
description: (Also offered as HRTS 3028W.) An introduction to the study and understanding of Aboriginal ways of life and thought. An exploration of the complexity of contemporary indigenous social orders and land rights issues. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: ANTH 2000.
